Native C++ forward simulators for network dynamics

simulate_dynamics.Rd

Fast native C++ simulators for Ising, compartmental epidemic (SI/SIS/SIR/SIRS and SEI/SEIR), Gaussian, and generalized Potts dynamics on networks, matching the generative likelihoods of pseudo_ising_block_state, epidemics_block_state, pseudo_normal_block_state, linear_normal_block_state, and pseudo_potts_block_state.

Usage

simulate_ising(graph, weights = 0.5, theta = 0, n_samples = 200L,
  burnin = 100L, thin = 1L, mode = c("equilibrium", "glauber"),
  has_zero = FALSE, init_state = NULL)

simulate_epidemics(graph, transmission = 0.3, spontaneous = 0.005,
  recovery = 0.2, resusceptible = 0.0,
  model = c("SI", "SIS", "SIR", "SIRS"),
  n_steps = 50L, n_cascades = 1L, exposed = FALSE, expose_rate = 0.5,
  init_infected = NULL)

simulate_normal_dynamics(graph, weights = 0.1, sigma = 1, mu = 0,
  n_samples = 200L, burnin = 100L, thin = 1L,
  mode = c("equilibrium", "glauber", "linear"))

simulate_potts(graph, weights = 0.5, f = diag(3), theta = NULL,
  n_samples = 200L, burnin = 100L, thin = 1L,
  mode = c("equilibrium", "glauber"), init_state = NULL)

Arguments

graph

A rgraphtool_graph on which to simulate dynamics.

weights

Edge coupling weight(s): scalar, edge property name, or numeric vector of length graph_num_edges(graph).

theta

Node external field(s) (scalar, length-\(N\) vector, or \(N \times q\) matrix for Potts).

n_samples, n_steps

Number of snapshots or time steps to record.

burnin, thin

Burn-in sweeps discarded and sweeps between consecutive recorded snapshots.

mode

Update schedule: "equilibrium" (asynchronous Gibbs sweeps), "glauber" (synchronous discrete-time updates), or "linear" (linear Gaussian difference equation).

has_zero

For simulate_ising(), sample spins in {-1, 0, +1} instead of {-1, +1}.

init_state, init_infected

Optional initial vertex states (or vector of initially infected 1-based vertex IDs for epidemics).

transmission

Edge transmission probability in [0, 1).

spontaneous

Per-step spontaneous infection probability in [0, 1).

recovery, resusceptible

Per-step recovery (1 -> 2 or 1 -> 0 in SIS) and waning-immunity (2 -> 0 in SIRS) probabilities.

model

Compartmental epidemic model ("SI", "SIS", "SIR", or "SIRS").

n_cascades

Number of independent epidemic cascades to simulate; if > 1, returns a list of \(N \times \mathrm{n\_steps}\) matrices.

exposed, expose_rate

Include an exposed compartment (-1) that transitions to infectious (1) with probability expose_rate.

sigma, mu

Node standard deviation(s) and mean(s) for Gaussian dynamics.

f

Square \(q \times q\) interaction matrix for Potts dynamics.

Value

An \(N \times M\) integer or numeric matrix of simulated node states (or a list of n_cascades matrices when simulate_epidemics() is called with n_cascades > 1).

See also

pseudo_ising_block_state, reconstruct_dynamics, demo("dynamics_reconstruction")

Examples

set.seed(1)
g <- graph_create(6, directed = FALSE)
graph_add_edges(g, rbind(cbind(1:5, 2:6), c(6L, 1L)))
s <- simulate_ising(g, weights = 0.5, n_samples = 20L, burnin = 20L)
dim(s)
#> [1]  6 20
